Name: Rezon, King of Damascus
Summary: Rezon, son of Eliadah, fled from his lord Hadadezer of Zobah, gathered men, became captain, and reigned in Damascus as an adversary to Solomon all his days.
KeyStory: Rezon becomes Solomon's adversary in Damascus.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Hadadezer, King of Zobah; Eliadah, Father of Rezon
LifeLesson: A runaway servant can become a king, and a king an adversary.
